settings.content: A swipe-based scent quiz shown as a popup site-wide. The visitor saves up to 6 favorites and is linked through to the bundle product with their picks pre-filled. On-site copy stays in Swedish; only these settings are in English.

settings.label: Bundle product
settings.info: Added to cart when a visitor taps "Build my bundle" after the quiz, with their picks recorded as line item properties, then taken straight to checkout. Required for that button - if left blank, it shows an inline error instead of adding to cart.

settings.label: Scent collection
settings.info: Required - products swiped through in the quiz deck. Until a collection with products is picked here, the trigger button stays visible but shows a notice instead of opening the quiz. Copy (tagline, "inspired by", mood tags, second photo) is read from each product's metafields where set - see the comment at the top of snippets/scent-quiz-popup.liquid for the exact fields.

settings.label: Variant to use
settings.info: For each product in the collection above, the variant whose title contains this text is used (e.g. "50" matches "50 ml"). Falls back to the product's first available variant if none match.

settings.label: Auto-open after
settings.info: 0 = auto-open disabled. Visitors can always open the quiz manually via the floating button.

settings.label: How often the popup should auto-open
Send saved scent boards to Klaviyo
Klaviyo public API key (Site ID)
settings.info: Klaviyo > Settings > API Keys > Public API Key. Safe to use in the browser.

settings.label: Klaviyo List ID
settings.info: The list the visitor's email should be added to. Klaviyo > Lists & Segments > open the list > List ID is in the URL.

settings.label: Show the location popup
settings.info: Untick to switch the popup off everywhere at once. Shopify's own automatic redirection must stay off (Online Store > Preferences > Automatic redirection > Country/region), otherwise visitors are moved before they see the question. Keep the Geo:Pro app embed off too: it asks the same question in its own bar.

settings.content: Asks visitors whose location (from their IP address) is one of your Markets countries, and whose prices would change on that country's version, whether they want to switch. Yes keeps the same page and its tracking links (UTMs) in their country's version. No keeps them where they are. A country picked in the header selector always wins. Never shown to search or ad crawlers or on account pages. Shopify's cookie banner goes first; the newsletter popup waits until this one is answered.

settings.label: Preview the popup in the theme editor
settings.info: Shows a sample (Poland) while you edit the text below, even when the popup is switched off. Visitors never see this preview. Untick when you are done.

settings.content: Testing on the live site: add ?geo_test=IE to any address to act as a visitor in Ireland, ?geo=reset to forget earlier answers in your browser, ?geo=off to hide the popup in that browser tab.

[country] becomes the visitor's country (Ireland, the United Kingdom) and [currency] its currency, for example EUR (€). [current_country] and [current_currency] are those of the page they are on. Don't start a sentence with a country token: some names begin with "the".

settings.label: Heading
settings.default: Hey, it looks like you're in [country]

settings.label: Text
settings.default: Do you want to go to our site for [country]? You'll see prices in [currency] instead of [current_currency].

settings.label: Small print under the buttons
settings.default: We'll remember your choice on this device.
settings.info: Tells visitors their answer is remembered, so it can't be removed: an empty box shows the default.

settings.label: Ask again after a No
settings.info: Closing the popup without answering (close button, Esc, tapping outside) asks again after 7 days at most.

settings.label: Take returning visitors who said Yes straight to their country's version
settings.info: Only when they arrive from outside the site and are still in that country, and only until they pick another country in the header selector. Untick to ask them again instead.

settings.content: One deadline for every sale countdown: the top bar and the Bundle & Save timer count down to the same moment.

settings.label: Daily reset time
settings.info: Visitor's local time. 0 = midnight: the timers count down to midnight and restart every day.

settings.label: Fixed end date (optional)
settings.info: Format: YYYY/MM/DD HH:MM:SS, visitor's local time. Until then the timers count down to this date; once it passes they go back to the daily reset. Leave empty for the daily countdown.

settings.content: Copy for the designer fragrance finder. The homepage band is the "FUEL_06 Fragrance finder" section; on product pages the finder opens from the link under the buy button. On-site copy is Swedish; the translation app handles the other markets. No prices are set here: the finder reads them from each product.

settings.label: Product page link: link text
settings.default: Find your designer scent for less

settings.label: Band heading
settings.default: Find your designer scent for less

settings.label: Heading word in green
settings.info: The first time this word appears in the band heading it is set in green italics. Leave it empty for a plain heading.

settings.label: Finder title
settings.default: Find your designer scent for less

settings.label: Search field label
settings.default: Search a perfume you already love

settings.label: Popular searches
settings.info: Separated by commas. Replace with the real top search terms from the Searchanise report.
settings.default: Sauvage, Baccarat Rouge 540, Opium, Bleu, Le Male

settings.label: How it works steps
settings.info: One step per line. They are numbered automatically.
settings.default:
Search a scent you already love
We find the closest MagyX scent
Compare the scent and what you save

settings.label: Close button label
settings.info: Read out by screen readers, not shown on screen.

settings.label: Loading subtitle
settings.default: We compare scent profile, notes and customer favorites.

settings.label: Loading footnote
settings.default: Our matching technology goes through thousands of reviews and fragrance data to find your perfect match.

settings.label: Result subtitle prefix
settings.info: The fragrance the shopper searched for is added after this.

settings.label: Inspired by prefix
settings.info: Never change this to a claim that our perfume is the same as the designer one.

settings.label: Note row labels
settings.info: Three labels separated by commas, in this order: top, heart, base. Kept short so they fit the 64px label column.

settings.label: Our column note
settings.info: Concentration of our own bottle. It is printed after the size the variant carries, so "100ML" and "Extrait de parfum" read as "100ML / Extrait de parfum".

settings.label: Designer column note
settings.info: Size and concentration of the designer bottle the price refers to. Change it as soon as one figure cannot stand for every fragrance.

settings.label: Savings percentage suffix
settings.info: The percentage is worked out from the product's own prices and printed before this word.

settings.label: Remove recent search label
settings.info: Read out by screen readers on the cross beside a remembered search, not shown on screen.

settings.label: Add to cart label
settings.info: The price is added after this, from the product itself.

settings.label: Search again label
settings.default: Not the right scent? Search again

settings.label: No result title
settings.info: The design has no no-result frame. This wording is a placeholder for Omar and Korana to replace.

settings.label: No result text
settings.default: We couldn't find that scent. Try another name, or pick one of the popular searches.

settings.label: Add to cart error
settings.default: Something went wrong. Please try again.

settings.label: Quantity breaker on product pages
settings.info: The Buy More Save More cards on product pages (single bottle / Buy 2 Get 1 Free / Buy 3 Get 2 Free). Off: product pages show the price and a plain Add to cart button; the automatic 25 / 30 / 35 / 40% discounts still apply in the cart.

settings.content: Lists used by the homepage product cards, review lines and the fragrance finder (port of tryscent.co). Empty = every card shows the full designer name, as on the rest of magyx.co. A brand listed here is removed from those names ("Tom Ford Oud Wood" -> "Oud Wood").

settings.label: Brands never named or shown
settings.info: One per line. Matched against the product's brand and its 'inspired by' name, case-insensitive. Add a brand here to strip it the same way.

settings.label: Brand names removed from every name
settings.info: One per line. Removed from every perfume name in search, collections, cards, bundle builders, the product page line and the browser tab; the perfume name stays ("Tom Ford Oud Wood" -> "Oud Wood"). Put longer forms first ("Paco Rabanne" before "Rabanne"). Case-sensitive.

settings.label: Perfume names never shown
settings.info: One per line. These names appear nowhere on the site (no "Inspirerad av" line, tab, Google texts, builders); search still finds the scent when someone types the name.

settings.label: Short names
settings.info: One per line: MAGYX number = the name shown after "Inspirerad av". Listed-brand scents: one word, never the full perfume name (e.g. 221 = Aqua, 132 = Opium). Any other number listed here overrides its name; scents without a line show their perfume name without the brand. Page titles and Google texts swap the full name for this one.
